itemdesc-barkstrip: A thin strip of bark. Right-click to inscribe a circle on it, hold right-click to cast what is written, sneak + right-click to edit it.
itemdesc-mosssigil: A pad of pressed living moss. Right-click to write a small circle on it, hold right-click to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
itemdesc-parchment: A scraped, stretched sheet of hide. Room for a full circle with its outer ring. Right-click to inscribe it, hold right-click to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
canvas-hint:
Circle: click a slot to select it, drag between two glyphs to link them, drag with right-click to unlink them.
Glyph: hold and sweep across points to draw, sweep with right-click to erase. Click a point to cycle its mark, right-click to clear it.
canvas-empty: Draw at least one glyph (with a line) before inscribing.
inscribe-nobark: Hold what you want to write on.
cast-cooldown: Your hand is still trembling from the last working.
cast-fizzle: The bark smoulders and crumbles. Nothing answers.
cast-backfire: The inks fight each other and the bark bursts in your hand!
